what: two 40x10x10 boxes 10 mm apart bridged along their top rims by the 40x10 sheet between them
method: the bridge sheet is the 40x10 = 400 mm^2 plane at z = 10 between the two top rims; area = 2*(2*(40*10 + 40*10 + 10*10)) + 400 = 3600 + 400 = 4000 mm^2. Three bodies: the two closed boxes and the sheet (not one closed solid, so valid is not asked). No volume: the open sheet has no enclosed volume.
